label: TP
reason: Assessed alert path: user input from request.getParameter flows through doSomething() via param.split(" ")[0] into bar, then bar.toCharArray() is written directly to response.getWriter() without HTML encoding. Splitting by space does not mitigate XSS - attacker can inject <script> tags that survive the split operation. X-XSS-Protection:0 header further reduces defense-in-depth.

evidence.note: User input flows through param.split()[0] to bar.toCharArray() written to response without HTML encoding
